title: Shortcircuit XT
summary: Shortcircuit XT is a creative sample-based synthesizer that goes way beyond what you would expect from a sampler. Four per-zone and per-group processors with various routings, extensive group trigger and playback options, in-depth modulation matrices (again, per-zone and per-group), 16-part multi-timbrality, flexible output mixer, modern amenities like MPE and MTS-ESP - all join hands together to form this celebration of sample-based (and then some) sound design.
